response.subject: This week at Yale: Silliman treats, Hot Murga, game night
response.intro: Here are the events worth a look this week, with free food first and a few other picks mixed in.

picks.line: Silliman sweet treats at the College St Gate before break, for Silliman students only.
A talk on culture, consent, and care, with hot food from Murga afterward.
Free family-style dinner at AACC for the November recess, open to everyone.
Casual game night at AACC on Wednesday evening, no sign-up needed.
The Handsome Dan weighing is a classic Yale tradition worth seeing once.
Short wellness check-ins at the YSC Offline Oasis, good for a quick break.
